feature1.prompt: The deprecation warning when empty data is passed to an axis with category units arises in the conversion logic. Currently, when the convert function is invoked with an empty data set, it erroneously raises a MatplotlibDeprecationWarning, even though there is no meaningful data to convert. The expected behavior is that empty data should allow the creation of artists without triggering a warning, ensuring that only non-empty, numlike inputs prompt deprecation messages. The fix must adjust the conversion process so that empty inputs bypass the warning mechanism, thereby preventing misleading error messages.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature involves updating the convert function in lib/matplotlib/category.py. Developers should add a check for empty data by ensuring that the values array is not empty (using a size check) before evaluating whether the data is numlike. The existing condition that tests if the values are numlike should be modified to 'if values.size and is_numlike', thereby preventing the deprecation warning when there is no data.
feature1.entrypoint: File: lib/matplotlib/category.py; Function: convert. Locate the conditional block near the original check for is_numlike (around line 58) and modify it to also verify that the values array is non-empty before triggering the warning.

feature2.prompt: The deprecation warning also occurs in the update logic when handling empty data for categorical units. The correct behavior should be to update the mapping without any warning when no actual data is present. The fix must adjust the update function to properly detect empty data and bypass the deprecation warning, ensuring that only meaningful updates (with non-empty data) trigger this alert.
feature2.hint_texts: This feature requires modifying the update method in lib/matplotlib/category.py. Developers need to add a condition that checks whether the data passed to update is empty before issuing the deprecation warning. In other words, change the condition from simply 'if convertible' to 'if data.size and convertible' so that empty input is handled gracefully.
feature2.entrypoint: File: lib/matplotlib/category.py; Function: update. Focus on the section that processes the mapping updates (starting around line 230) and insert a check for data.size to ensure that the warning is only logged when actual data is being processed.
